0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets host the Golden State Warriors in their 12th game of the season, with Houston at 8-3 overall and 5-1 at home, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West, while Golden State is also 8-3 but is riding an eight-game winning streak after going 8-2 in its last ten. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), both out, and Oscar Tshiebwe (illness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Brandon Williams (hamstring) and Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco in their most recent meeting on April 5, 2026.
